description:
"Which do you prefer, Hyewon? Do you want me to love you, or not to love you?"

"...What's the difference?"

"If I love you, you have to love me back."

"What kind of nonsense is that? Is that a condition?"

"Like living together and touching each other makes us something like a couple?"

"If I don’t love you, then you’ll just end up caught by some bastard and be forced to live getting raped, so you can hate me all you want. Either way, I’ll still throw flowers at you, but I’ll let you decide whichever makes you feel more at ease."

Hyewon genuinely scoffed. This coercive savior says he'll even make people what she wants. Even though that's not love.
